metadata.description: Thomas Kejser's personal Claude Code plugins — coding conventions and workflow skills.

plugins.name: kejser-web
plugins.description: SvelteKit stack and conventions: default stack and scaffolding, every UX control is a component, semantic CSS with no Tailwind, adapter-node deploys, static content sites, publishing them to cPanel over FTPS, and SVG social media logos.

plugins.name: kejser-code
plugins.description: Which language for which work, plus language-agnostic, C++ and Rust conventions: minimal contract-only comments, fail loudly, modern C++, self-contained Rust binaries, SQL and database design, ETL, Markdown style, and how agents commit and report in shared trees.
